legacy: Original unfiltered21-input dataset remains a separate future control; it is never overwritten
readiness: Both payloads use exactly the same accepted latest-observation alignment. No imputation, fallback, lag/age change or ready-indicator input.
training_segment_rule: Partition original ordered rows on unready dates and preceding20-session purge; discard all segments shorter than513 bars. Require exactly one remaining segment per original symbol/episode. Reject rather than choose among multiple eligible segments or drop a symbol.
evaluation: Every original validation row must be ready; preserve all26 original development episodes and dates exactly. Never filter validation, add test, shift dates or rank by returns.
normalization: Preserve the original seven names/means/scales byte-for-byte. Fit only the two new full-arm columns on retained training rows. Masked extra raw values/means zero and scales one. No validation fit or clipping.
row_lineage: Record exact original half-open row bounds, exclusion counts and source episode hashes. All retained bars/ATR/original seven fields remain exact; source episode keys and symbol order remain unchanged.
sampling: Existing stock_etf_cycle_windows remains unchanged; both payloads must retain all111 unique training symbols and the same512-step eligible start counts. Future comparison keeps4/26 ETF and22/26 stock mass, never return-based sampling.
interpretation: Payload preprocessing/eligibility acceptance only. A separate fixed matched experiment, shared initializers, actual Colab smokes and multi-seed/prospective gates remain required before performance claims. No closed family is reopened.
